defs.def: a unit for measuring angles 度，度数（角的量度单位）
a unit for measuring temperature 度，度数（温度单位）

ex.s: It's between minus eight and minus two degrees.
ex.t: 气温在零下八度到零下二度之间。

ex.s: Today the temperature in London is expected to reach 30 plus degrees!
ex.t: 今天伦敦气温预计达到30多度！

ex.s: The average high temperature in July is only 22 degrees, so over 30 is not usual for London.
ex.t: 七月平均高温只有22度，所以超过30度对伦敦来说不寻常。

ex.s: Because there’s no air conditioning, the temperature inside the train can reach 35 degrees!
ex.t: 因为没有空调，车内温度可以达到35度！

defs.def: the amount or level of sth 程度

ex.s: Given the degree of doubt, Mr Stienwand suggests, “it would be wise to stop cloud seeding.” In practice, doubt has had the opposite effect.
ex.t: 鉴于怀疑的程度，斯坦万德先生建议：“停止人工降雨是明智的。”但在实践中，怀疑产生了相反的效果。

ex.s: In my experience, most people think they have a sense of humor, and to some degree that’s true.
ex.t: 依我的经验，大多数人都认为自己有幽默感，而且在某种程度上这是真的。

defs.def: the qualification obtained by students who successfully complete a university or college course （大学）学位

ex.s: After my undergraduate degree, convinced that writing wasn’t for me, I ____43____ to study teaching.
ex.t: 本科毕业后，我认定写作不适合我，便____43____去学教学。

ex.s: “I have my degree in education, but I had been staying home with my kids, ” Drewry says.
ex.t: "我有教育学学位，但一直在家带孩子，"德鲁里说。

ex.s: When I decided to pursue a postgraduate degree, I wanted to develop a novel research programme and quickly establish myself as an independent scientist.
ex.t: 当我决定攻读研究生学位时，我想开发一个新颖的研究项目，并迅速确立自己作为独立科学家的地位。

ex.s: Who was the first African American with a medical degree?
ex.t: 谁是第一位获得医学学位的非裔美国人？

ex.s: Take a degree.
ex.t: 攻读学位。

ex.s: You may pursue training, degrees, or increasing levels of responsibility at work.
ex.t: 你可以在工作中追求培训、学位或不断提高的责任层级。

ex.s: At 21, I landed a job at a big insurance company out of my business degree.
ex.t: 21岁时，凭借商科学位，我在一家大型保险公司谋得一份工作。

ex.s: You are studying in a graduate program for a master's degree．
ex.t: 你正在攻读硕士学位的研究生项目中学习。

ex.s: hold a master's degree in science
ex.t: 持有理学硕士学位

ex.s: She chose the UW-Eau Claire program at Ministry Saint Joseph’s Hospital in Marshfield because she was able to pursue her four-year degree close to home.
ex.t: 她选择了位于马什菲尔德的明斯特圣约瑟夫医院的UW-Eau Claire项目，因为她能在离家近的地方攻读四年制学位。

ex.s: Jennifer received great support from her family as she worked to earn her degree: Her husband worked two jobs to cover the bills, and her 68-year-old mother helped take care of the children at times.
ex.t: 珍妮弗在努力攻读学位的过程中得到了家人的大力支持：她的丈夫打两份工来支付账单她68岁的母亲有时帮忙照看孩子。

ex.s: However, her children have learned an important lesson witnessing their mother earn her degree.
ex.t: 然而，她的孩子们目睹母亲获得学位，学到了重要的一课。

ex.s: You have a job, earned your degree, and you got out of bed today.
ex.t: 你有工作，拿到了学位，而且今天你起了床。

ex.s: What did Leaney study for a degree?
ex.t: 利尼为了学位学了什么？

ex.s: To get a degree in engineering.
ex.t: （翻译待校对补充）

ex.s: A special low entrance charge of £2 per person is available to all in full-time education, up to and including those at first degree level, in organised groups with teachers.
ex.t: 对所有全日制教育者，包括处于本科学位层次的人，在有教师组织的团体中，每人2英镑的特别低入场费适用。

ex.s: find a vacancy after degree students’ enrollment
ex.t: 在学位生注册后找到空缺

ex.s: help the students apply for a degree
ex.t: 帮助学生申请学位

ex.s: That willpower bore fruit when Jennifer graduated from University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire and became the first in her large family to earn a bachelor’s degree.
ex.t: 当詹妮弗从威斯康星大学欧克莱尔分校毕业、成为这个大家庭里第一个获得学士学位的人时，那份意志力结出了果实。

ex.s: After school she plans to take a year off to model full-time before going to university to get a degree  68        engineering or architecture.
ex.t: 毕业后她计划休学一年全职当模特，然后上大学去获得____68____工程或建筑的学位。

ex.s: After taking a degree at Chichester University in Related Arts, Ginni began to travel the world, eventually getting work teaching English in Japan and Chile.
ex.t: 在Chichester大学获得相关艺术学位后，Ginni开始周游世界，最终在日本和智利找到了教英语的工作。

ex.s: Jennifer Mauer has needed more willpower than the typical college student to pursue her goal of earning a nursing degree.
ex.t: Jennifer Mauer比典型的大学生更需要意志力来追求她获得护理学位的目标.

ex.s: She received dozens of awards and more than 50 honorary degrees.
ex.t: 她获得了数十个奖项以及50多个荣誉学位。

defs.def: a university or college course, normally lasting three years or more （大学通常三年或以上的）学位课程
a level in a scale of how serious sth is 严重程度（或级别）
